question: For $A=\begin{bmatrix}k&1&2\\3&4&0\\1&2&5\end{bmatrix}$, determine $k$ if the minors $M_{11}$ and $M_{22}$ are equal. Verify the equality for the obtained value.
explanation:
Calculation of $M_{11}$
Deleting the first row and first column gives $$M_{11}=\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\2&5\end{vmatrix}=20$$
Calculation of $M_{22}$
Deleting the second row and second column gives $$M_{22}=\begin{vmatrix}k&2\\1&5\end{vmatrix}=5k-2$$
Application of the equality
Since $M_{11}=M_{22}$, $$20=5k-2$$ Thus, $$5k=22$$ and $$k=\frac{22}{5}$$
Verification
For $k=\frac{22}{5}$, $$M_{22}=5\left(\frac{22}{5}\right)-2=22-2=20=M_{11}$$
Hence, $k=\frac{22}{5}$.
